en-US.description: A desktop front end for winget: update, install, uninstall, pin and export packages.
en-US.longDescription:
A Windows desktop front end for winget. Everything happens in one table with checkboxes:
update what has a newer version, install something new by searching as you type, list and
uninstall what is already there, pin what must not be touched, and export or import the whole
package list to rebuild a machine.

Light and dark theme, no telemetry. Installs for all users with a Start menu entry and
uninstalls from Windows Settings. Requires administrator rights, which it asks for at startup.
en-US.name: WinGet Studio
en-US.releaseNotes:
Import shows the packages in the file before installing them, so you can leave some out.
Lists refresh themselves after an operation, and Retry failed runs it again on the packages
where it failed. Details in the right-click menu shows a package as winget describes it,
and search results show each package's source. The self-update checks that the download is
signed with the WinGet Studio key. Install results are classified correctly again, and the
log can be saved or cleared. New icon.
